subject.title: Plugin register() promises silently ignored — async registration not awaited

question: Should nix-openclaw treat asynchronous OpenClaw runtime-plugin registration as an upstream lifecycle/API request, or is there evidence of a specific packaged plugin artifact that this repository should replace or constrain?
rationale: The package layer can pin or package plugin roots, but changing whether registration promises are awaited changes the upstream runtime contract and cannot be safely inferred from one warning line.

options.title: Route upstream contract work
options.body: Request the concrete plugin details, then file or link an upstream OpenClaw lifecycle issue if the plugin requires asynchronous registration.

options.title: Repair a verified artifact mismatch
options.body: If the supplied plugin root is packaged incorrectly by nix-openclaw, make a narrow packaging or catalog correction without changing the upstream lifecycle contract.

recommendation.title: Route upstream contract work
recommendation.body: Request the concrete plugin details, then file or link an upstream OpenClaw lifecycle issue if the plugin requires asynchronous registration.

likelyOwner.reason: The timeline explicitly routed the lifecycle question to cpojer, making them the best available decision contact.
